intro.text: A little-understood power on Roshar, connected to Odium. Predicting the future is said to be of it.

description.text: Khriss's Ars Arcanum says there are ten levels of Voidbinding and refers to "Voidbindings", but what this means is unknown.
Voidbinding is connected to Odium, and predicting the future is said to be of it.
The Ars Arcanum also calls it a cousin to the Old Magic.

items.text: Prophecy and foresight are among the powers most associated with Voidbinding. Ardents say even the Heralds denounced it, and in Vorin nations any prediction is taboo.
That reluctance gave rise to games like breakneck that avoid guessing the future directly, and many Vorins distrust stormwardens for predicting highstorms.
The ardents worry that Dalinar's visions are connected to Voidbinding.
Nightform, one of the Regal forms of power, has the Voidbinding power of future sight.
Renarin's ability to see the future seems connected to Voidbinding, likely gained through his bond to the corrupted spren Glys.
Renarin's future sight is imperfect: what he foresees during the Battle of Thaylen Field does not come to pass.
Renarin can't use Illumination in the usual way, so his visions may come from a Voidish form of that Surge.
